title: "PyTorch ao"
description: "Custom data types and layouts for training and inference"
---

To use experimental optimizers (`AdamWFp8`, `AdamW4bit`, `AdamW8bit`) from Pytorch Ao, please install the package as shown below.

::: {.callout-tip}
Some experimental optimizers are already present in regular Pytorch, so please re-check if you actually need this package!
:::

### Installation

Stable Release from the PyTorch index

```bash
pip install torchao --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu121 # full options are cpu/cu118/cu121/cu124
```


Nightly release

```bash
pip install --pre torchao-nightly --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/nightly/cu121 # full options are cpu/cu118/cu121/cu124
```

### Native NVFP4 LoRA with DDP

For a serialized, frozen native TorchAO weight-only NVFP4 base with ordinary PEFT LoRA, DDP automatically verifies component layouts and synchronizes the raw NVFP4 components from rank zero before wrapping the model. LoRA adapters continue through ordinary DDP reduction; no configuration flag is required. This path is qualified for two-rank regular weight-only LoRA training, checkpoint resume, and adapter save. Dynamic activation NVFP4 training eligibility remains separately restricted, while this component synchronization also serves verified dynamic callers. Non-DDP distributed backends remain outside this path.
